Data and sources

What the numbers and photos represent.

Shopping and prices

Choose Canada for CAD or the United States for USD. Buying links are available for every catalog entry. Search links do not guarantee availability or a matching variant.

Checked prices are time-stamped snapshots of exact retailer listings. They expire after 24 hours and are not automatically refreshed continuously. Lowest checked price means the lowest among the displayed offers, not every retailer. Coverage is limited while more product listings and retailer feeds are connected.

Build subtotals include only parts with a valid checked price, including repeated items. Missing prices are excluded and counted separately. Taxes, shipping, coupons, mail-in rebates and membership discounts are not included. Confirm final pricing and stock at checkout.

Specifications & missing data

Each part links to its source. Charts use a shared unit and start at zero. A dash means unavailable, not zero. Product names, years, and specifications come from the existing catalog; source availability can change.

PC frame-rate calculations

The FPS calculator produces an estimated range, not a measured benchmark. Each game has a calibrated 1080p workload baseline. The calculator scales that baseline using the selected GPU’s PassMark G3D score, resolution, quality and upscaling, then applies a CPU ceiling derived from the selected processor’s core count and boost clock. VRAM below a game’s profile reduces the estimate. The displayed low and high values add a conservative variance band for drivers, patches, thermals, memory and scene complexity.

PassMark G3D values are an inherited September 12, 2026 snapshot from PassMark and aggregate different systems. They are used as a scaling input, not presented as game benchmark results.

Console frame-rate data

Console cards report modes, targets or caps published by game and platform owners. “Target” does not guarantee a locked frame rate. Resolution can be dynamic, reconstructed or upscaled. Each card links to its source and identifies whether the number is an official mode or a tested target.

PC compatibility checks

The builder checks indexed sockets, memory, storage ports, slots, and power. Its estimate adds CPU TDP, GPU board power, and 100 W, then adds a 25% margin. Verify BIOS, dimensions, cooling, and exact connectors separately. Hardware outlooks are estimates, not benchmarks.

Product images

Photos may show the selected product or a related variant. Each product page names the model pictured and links to its image source. Confirm the exact appearance with the manufacturer before buying.
